# Best Tort Lawyers

Best Tort Lawyers is a free matching and information service — not a law firm. Talk to Sofia, the AI intake assistant, by chat, voice, call, or callback request to find out if your situation may be a claim. Free, confidential, private by default.

## Pages

- [Talk to Sofia](https://besttortlawyers.com/): Chat with Sofia in your own words, call (202) 932-9700, or request a callback. Free, confidential case review.
- [Privacy Policy](https://besttortlawyers.com/privacy-policy/): What information is collected and how it is used.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://besttortlawyers.com/terms-and-conditions/): Rules for using the site and talking to Sofia.
- [SMS Terms](https://besttortlawyers.com/sms-terms/): Text-message terms and opt-out.
